items.title: Agent Memory with Episodic Retrieval for Financial Decision-Making
items.title_zh: 面向金融决策的情景记忆检索智能体
items.summary: META is a multi-agent trading framework that combines specialized indicator agents with a decision agent and an episodic memory module storing past market states, outcomes and reflections; recalling similar regimes improves directional accuracy and robustness in short-horizon evaluation.

items.title: Advancing Private AI Compute with secure, server-side memory
items.title_zh: 以安全服务器端记忆推进私有 AI 计算
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduces private, server-side memory to Private AI Compute for personal AI, according to the announcement.

items.title: Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models
items.title_zh: 超越上下文窗口：混合检索与长上下文模型的自适应熵路由框架
items.summary: EDAR uses predictive entropy over the first generated tokens to decide whether to answer from retrieved chunks or escalate to full long-context processing; on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench it retains 97.4% of long-context accuracy while cutting token expenditure by 70.7% and escalating only 18.2% of queries.

items.title: RECLAIM: Can Agents Reproduce the Claims of Machine Learning Papers?
items.title_zh: RECLAIM：智能体能否复现机器学习论文的论断？
items.summary: RECLAIM benchmarks agents on reproducing a pre-specified result from 100 NeurIPS 2025 papers under a fixed GPU-hour budget; with four agents each run once per paper, the best agent in each tier reproduces 41% of Run-tier papers, 27% at Retrain and 15% at Reimplement.

items.title: Looks the Same, Answers Differently: Flip-Direction Steering for Robust Vision-Language Reasoning
items.title_zh: 看起来相同却答案不同：面向鲁棒视觉语言推理的翻转方向引导
items.summary: FlipDir is a training-free inference-time method that estimates a low-rank flip-inducing activation subspace from contrastive input pairs and steers hidden states during decoding, with a margin-based gate that limits intervention to uncertain steps so stable predictions are preserved; on the new VisFlip benchmark it outperforms existing methods across 18 settings on combined recovery and preservation.

items.title: The Fellowship of the Query: Learning Retrieval Actions
items.title_zh: 查询远征：学习检索动作
items.summary: The paper fine-tunes small language models as next-action controllers for retrieval-augmented QA over seven structured actions; Granite 4.1 3B reaches macro-F1 0.6536 on 1,646 held-out examples versus 0.1736 zero-shot, and using the tuned model as both controller and generator lifts Exact Match from 0.7530 to 0.7946.

items.title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 智能体编辑世界模型：重新思考 LLM 智能体的世界建模
items.summary: AEWM models how reasoning and actions shape future task progress instead of predicting tool responses, combining an Action Judge that labels decisions as critical, exploratory or noisy with State Revision that edits contaminated history; EditAct improves average scores by 3.2-6.7 points across six benchmarks and three backbones.

items.title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
items.title_zh: Harvey 借助 GPT-6 Astra 把法律上下文变成更强的草稿
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helps Harvey produce more structured, context-aware legal documents, freeing lawyers to focus on strategy.

items.title: Ringg’s AI agents resolve up to 65% of customer calls with OpenAI
items.title_zh: Ringg 的 AI 智能体借助 OpenAI 解决高达 65% 的客户来电
items.summary: OpenAI reports that Ringg uses GPT-5.6 to power multilingual voice, chat, WhatsApp and web agents that resolve up to 65% of customer calls at 90% lower cost than GPT-4.1.
